sections.text_helper: Section 78.8 "Chip-level TAP controller (CLTAPC)" in chapter 78 (Debug support (DBG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4381.
sections.section_content:
The JTAG interface is connected to the internal scan chain of the device. It is used for
testing as well as for debug. The first component in the scan chain is the chip-level TAP
controller, which implements a TAP state machine based on IEEE Std 1149.1-1990. It
allowsaccess to the built-in manufacturing test features.
The CLTAPC must be bypassed in order to access the debug support functions provided by
the SWJ-DP. This is done by prefixing SWJ-DP instructions with the CLTAPC bypass
instruction sequence (0b11111).
